items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson full participant Thursday for second straight day; poised to return vs BUF after missing three games with ankle.
items.why: Full practices Wed-Thu; Rapoport confirms poised for return.
items.implication: Unlocks Ravens offense and Flowers usage.
items.opportunity: Full snap share likely; boost to pass catchers

items.text: Patriots WR AJ Brown not practicing Thursday due to flared-up knee issue (also ankle); status for Sunday vs MIA up in the air.
items.why: Knee flare added to ankle; not spotted at practice.
items.implication: High risk sit or GTD; monitor Friday report closely.
items.opportunity: Targets to other NE WRs/TE if OUT

items.text: Pat Thorman (ETR) didn't love the look of Christian Watson's collarbone after hit; Watson coughed blood but cleared CT and returned for big night.
items.why: Visual concern on collarbone; precautionary exit then return.
items.implication: Monitor for lingering issues next week; played through.
items.opportunity: If limited later, boost to other GB WRs

items.text: Matthew Berry hates Jaylen Waddle this week; production lacking and Chiefs allow just one WR TD all season (to JSN).
items.why: Poor recent prod + tough KC secondary matchup.

items.text: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase full participant Thursday after DNP Wednesday (ankle/rest).
items.implication: Expected to play full role vs TEN.

items.text: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) and WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) both full participants Thursday after DNPs Wednesday.
items.implication: Both expected to play vs MIN with normal roles.

items.text: Matthew Berry loves Zay Flowers as WR5 this week; Lamar return unlocks him in track-meet vs BUF.
Since Caleb Williams return, Colston Loveland averaging 30% target share and 19.2 PPG; top-5 TE both weeks, leads utilization.
Adam Levitan notes Jaxon Smith-Njigba truly special: 9 more fantasy points than opportunity implies despite losing OC Kubiak, heavy coverage, few other threats.
items.why: Efficiency crushing opportunity post-OC loss and shaded coverage.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle aggravated previous chest injury; status for Sunday vs KC TBD based on practice.
Seahawks designated RB Jadarian Price for return to practice.
Berry loves Derrick Henry (RB6 @BUF) and Chase Brown (RB8 vs TEN) for soft run defenses and TD luck regression.
Berry hates Saquon Barkley (RB20 @WSH) on usage concerns and Omarion Hampton (RB34 @LAR) lacking real role.
items.why: Barkley usage dip; Hampton no established role.

items.text: Berry loves Josh Jacobs (RB11 vs CAR) against Panthers defense that has been nightmare for opposing backs.
